DETERMINATION

Meridian Health Plan has completed review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted, an adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity has been issued. The medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

This adverse determination is reported with the following codes:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

CRITERIA APPLIED

Review was conducted using the InterQual-style criteria set applicable to the admission under review. The following criteria codes were not met:

CHF-01: Oxygen saturation at presentation did not show hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen therapy.

CHF-03: There was no documented trial of intensified outpatient therapy before admission.

No other criteria codes were applied to this determination. This notice addresses medical necessity only and no other basis of review.

MEMBER AND PROVIDER LIABILITY

The member is not responsible for charges denied under this adverse determination except as permitted by the provider's participation agreement and applicable law. The provider may not bill the member for amounts denied as not medically necessary.

APPEAL RIGHTS

A Level 1 appeal may be submitted by letter or by portal upload. The appeal submission should cite the criteria codes inline, specifically CHF-01 and CHF-03, and state the clinical basis on which each is contested. Please attach the History and Physical and the progress notes for the admission spanning [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]]. Appeal submissions are subject to a five page limit, exclusive of attached medical records. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that deadline may be closed without substantive review.

A physician reviewer was available to discuss this adverse determination prior to issuance and remains available upon request through the Utilization Management Department.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Meridian Health Plan
